1 · “Your course”: calm and detailed, in Cream and Navy

Every unit is its own landmark: a chart house for Budgeting, a harbor for Saving, a market for Banking, cargo for Your first paycheck, a bridge for Debt & credit, the lighthouse for Scams… The current unit is bigger and highlighted, with the boat. Finished units have a flag and a check; the next ones sit in the mist. Calm: cards on a dotted route. Detailed: a sea chart with soft waves, buoys, birds and open water at the end. The full screens scroll; these are photographed whole.

2 · The lighthouse's beam sweeps, slowly

A soft cone of light sweeps across and back about every 6 seconds, brightening as it passes the middle. Used in the Scams picture, its island on the map, and the “Practice opens soon” empty screen. With Reduce motion it stays still, at the middle. Frames below; lighthouse.webm shows it moving.

3 · Cream and Navy (and Match my device)

Settings → Look: Cream, Navy, or Match my device. Navy is designed, not inverted: deep navy pages, cream type, cream sails and islands, a warmer coral that still glows, the sea map's mist lightened for dark water. The real app's screens below (built on the branch), side by side.

Northvale6Ask
AskExplain this
Explain this · Simple
This is a payday loan offer

They lend $500 and charge $75 every two weeks. Over a year that's like paying about 390% interest. A credit card is usually 20–30%.

The numbers that matter
$75 fee every 2 weeks≈ 390% a year
Red flags
• “Offer ends tonight”: pressure to decide fast• Fees every two weeks, with no total shown• “No credit check” often means a very high price
Lesson: Borrowing costs money
For learning, not advice. We hid a card number before sending, and nothing you pasted is saved.
